levels.surface: محمد بن عبد العزيز بن أبي رزمة

notes: No «ح» or «قالا» joins the two routes: each is written in full; route 1 stops at Ibn Shihab and the text writes no tail for it
Route 2 carries the saying through Urwa to Aisha, the last link
«أبو صالح، سلمويه» is one man written with a comma (Ex4 pattern)
